title: The Seven Churches (5-7)
intro: The last three churches. Sardis has a reputation for being alive, but is dead. Philadelphia receives only praise. Laodicea is lukewarm.

persons.name: Sardis
persons.description: Has the name of being alive, but is dead. A few have not soiled their garments.
persons.note: Praise: a few faithful ones. Criticism: spiritually dead

persons.name: Philadelphia
persons.description: Have endured and not denied Jesus' name. Given an open door. No criticism.
persons.note: Praise: faithful with little strength. Criticism: none

persons.name: Laodicea
persons.description: Lukewarm - neither cold nor hot. Think they are rich, but are poor and naked.
persons.note: Praise: none. Criticism: lukewarm and self-satisfied
